assessment_summary:
I validated the IT-Fachplanung DDEV installation in /workspace (commit 786839b) by inspecting the running environment and exercising the software, following the supplied guide.

Method/inspection: Confirmed ddev v1.25.4 + Docker and the tfm-fachplanung project config (PHP 8.3, MariaDB 10.3, apache-fpm, docroot public). `ddev describe` reports web, db, openldap, phpmyadmin and phpldapadmin all OK and containers healthy. Dependencies are installed (Composer 2.10.3, vendor/ present; Node 24, 451 node_modules incl. gulp; php-cs-fixer/phpstan/rector present). The DB dump is imported (9 tables, with 53 fachplanung rows for 2023/2024 and 1000+ massnahme rows). config/web.config.local.php exists and its LDAP block correctly targets the compose `openldap` service (the shipped example references a stale planetexpress endpoint, so the installer's alignment was needed). LDAP holds 10 inetOrgPerson users and the application's own LdapUtility connects, binds and searches successfully (entries=11). HTTP behavior is correct: `/` redirects to `/login` (302), login renders 200, authenticated login as the documented r1 credentials succeeds (302 -> / -> 200) and all main authenticated pages (/documentation, administration/it-gesamtplan, benutzerverwaltung, dienststellen) return 200; built CSS/JS assets are served. Custom ddev commands from the guide (build, fixPhp, cypress, importDump, setup-docu-data) are registered.

Behavioral checks: I ran the real Cypress suite against the running app. 01-infrastruktur_setup passes 4/4 and 02-benutzerverwaltung passes 5/5 (including the LDAP-search scenario), demonstrating that infrastructure setup, user management and LDAP integration operate end-to-end.

Failures and why they are not installation defects: 030, 031, 032 and 033 fail. I investigated rather than assuming, and traced the cause to the documentation test-data helper and the container clock: the container date is 2026, so only 2027 is allowed as a new plan year; scripts/setup_docu_data.php inserts a 2026 plan via direct SQL, bypassing GesamtPlan::createGesamtplan and therefore creating no dynform_field definitions, while the test hardcodes 2027. FachPlanung::copyMassnahmen then builds `INSERT ... (...,full_text,) SELECT ...` with an empty dynamic-field list, leaving a trailing comma and causing MariaDB error 1064 ("Datenbank-Fehler (2)"), so no Fachplanung is created and downstream specs fail. I confirmed this is data/clock-dependent, not an app defect, by invoking the real code with a field-bearing predecessor: addFachPlanung('9901', GesamtPlan 2024) returns OK and copies rows; on a pristine guide-following dump (2023/2024, which do carry 33+50 field rows) the create-plan -> create-Fachplanung workflow inherits fields correctly.

Limitations: the `ddev cypress` host command could not be used verbatim, so I ran the equivalent Cypress container attached to the project network (the compose service definition is present and correct). I did not re-import the DB dump because that would alter the installation; instead I validated the relevant code paths directly.

Overall: objective evidence shows every install step in the guide completed and the application is operational (services healthy, dependencies installed, DB imported, LDAP connected, login and pages working, assets built, primary functional specs passing). The unpassing checks are documentation-generation specs affected by test-data/year assumptions, which do not indicate an incomplete installation. I therefore assess the outcome as success, with this caveat documented.
